question: Manika Batra won the 82nd Senior National Table Tennis Championship (Female Category) held at Panchkula in ___________ 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**February.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The India's highest level table tennis player **Manika Batra beat Reeth Rishya **in the ladies' singles last to win the** 82nd** Senior Public Table Tennis Title.
 
• Manika Batra secured her subsequent title by overcoming Reeth Rishya **4-2 **in the ladies' singles last of the Senior Public Table Tennis Title.
 
• She is the most significant level female table tennis player in India and situated** 50th in the world as of Walk 2022.**
 
• She was conceded the Major** Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2020.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Awards**

 
 
• **2020** – Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna, highest sporting honour of India.
 
• **2018** – Arjuna Award, second-highest sporting honour of India.
 
• **2018** – The Breakthrough Star Award by ITTF.
 
 
 
• The star paddler, who won four decorations in **Gold Coast - - 2 gold, 1 silver and 1 bronze. Batra** lost all her four occasions in the quarter-last stages.
